name: Secutor
description: Secutor is a local-first secure packet utility. It creates an encrypted on-device vault with an app PIN plus Android Keystore biometric gate, generates X25519, Ed25519, ML-KEM, and ML-DSA identities locally, and exports CPKT1 encrypted/signed message objects that can travel over any external transport. There is no account, network service, cloud sync, escrow, or recovery path, and private keys are not exported by the app.
releaseNotes: v0.1.1 release: Secutor visible app identity, guarded attachment picker launch, streaming 5 MiB attachment cap, local AES-256-GCM vault encrypted by an Argon2id-derived key, no recovery path, Android backups disabled, screenshots blocked by default, contact invites and classical/PQ fingerprints, X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid packet encryption, Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 packet signatures, clipboard auto-clear, configurable idle lock, and root/integrity warnings.
